zh.criteria: 储物柜旁的一把椅子悬在地面上方，椅脚没有支撑。
zh.expected: 椅脚应接触地面。
zh.steps: 沿装配线旁的通道走到储物柜前，从侧面观察椅脚。

en.criteria: A chair beside the lockers floats above the floor with no support beneath its legs.
en.expected: The chair legs should rest on the floor.
en.steps: Walk along the assembly aisle to the lockers and inspect the chair legs from the side.

tasks.title: 装配车间椅子重复穿插

zh.criteria: 储物柜旁的两把椅子相互穿插，椅背和座面占据同一空间。
zh.expected: 两把椅子应占据独立空间。
zh.steps: 沿通道走到储物柜旁，从正面和侧面检查重叠的椅背与座面。

en.criteria: Two chairs beside the lockers intersect through their backs and seats.
en.expected: The chairs should occupy separate spaces.
en.steps: Walk along the aisle to the lockers and inspect the overlapping chair backs and seats from the front and side.

zh.criteria: 同一排中一个储物柜异常放大，与相邻同款柜子的比例明显不一致。
zh.expected: 同款储物柜应保持相近的尺寸。
zh.steps: 走到通道一端的储物柜前，比较柜门高度和宽度。

en.criteria: One locker is enlarged far beyond the proportions of the matching lockers beside it.
en.expected: Matching lockers should have comparable dimensions.
en.steps: Walk to the lockers at the end of the aisle and compare their door heights and widths.

zh.criteria: 人物可以走入外观完整的储物柜内部。
zh.expected: 实体柜门和柜身应阻挡人物。
zh.steps: 对准该排最右侧储物柜，持续向前走并观察是否进入柜体。

en.criteria: The player can walk into a visibly solid locker.
en.expected: The solid locker door and body should block the player.
en.steps: Face the rightmost locker in the row and walk forward to check whether the character enters it.

zh.criteria: 装配线旁一段看起来畅通的通道被看不见的障碍阻挡。
zh.expected: 没有可见障碍的通道应允许正常通过。
zh.steps: 从起点沿长通道向前行走，检查无法继续前进的位置。

en.criteria: An apparently clear section of the assembly aisle is blocked by an invisible obstacle.
en.expected: The unobstructed aisle should allow normal passage.
en.steps: From the starting area, walk along the long aisle and inspect the point where movement stops.

zh.criteria: 碰到通道旁的椅子后，椅子持续快速左右抖动，离开后仍不停。
zh.expected: 普通碰触不应使椅子持续自行抖动。
zh.steps: 走向椅子直到接触，然后后退并观察一秒以上。

en.criteria: After the player bumps the chair beside the aisle, it rapidly jitters sideways and continues after contact ends.
en.expected: An ordinary bump should not make a chair jitter indefinitely.
en.steps: Walk into the chair, step back, and observe it for more than a second.

zh.criteria: 水箱移到视野中央时消失，移到视野边缘后又出现。
zh.expected: 转动视角时，无遮挡的水箱应持续可见。
zh.steps: 靠近测试区水箱，对准它后再缓慢向侧面转动视角。

en.criteria: The water container disappears at the center of the view and reappears toward its edge.
en.expected: An unobstructed container should remain visible as the camera turns.
en.steps: Approach the water container, look directly at it, then slowly turn the camera sideways.

tasks.title: 金属桶随距离突兀消失

zh.criteria: 沿畅通的通道稍微后退，前排金属桶就突然消失；靠近时重新出现。
zh.expected: 这个距离范围内，无遮挡的金属桶应始终可见。
zh.steps: 面向金属桶，向后走约三米再走回来。

en.criteria: A front-row metal drum abruptly disappears when the player backs away along the clear aisle and returns on approach.
en.expected: The unobstructed drum should stay visible over this distance range.
en.steps: Face the drums, back up about three meters, then approach again.

tasks.title: 防撞设施随距离改变大小

zh.criteria: 地面防撞设施在远近观察间突然变大或缩小，改变了与周围物体的比例。
zh.expected: 观察距离不应改变物体的世界尺寸。
zh.steps: 面向通道边的防撞设施，后退约三米再靠近。

en.criteria: The floor-mounted bumper abruptly grows or shrinks with viewing distance, changing its proportions relative to nearby objects.
en.expected: Viewing distance should not change an object’s world dimensions.
en.steps: Face the bumper beside the aisle, back up about three meters, then approach it.

zh.criteria: 看过前排右侧金属桶后转身再回来，它无缘无故消失了。
zh.expected: 无人搬动时，金属桶应留在原处。
zh.steps: 先看清前排右侧金属桶，转身看向另一边，再回头检查。

en.criteria: After the player observes the front-right metal drum and looks away, it is missing on return.
en.expected: The drum should remain in place when nobody moves it.
en.steps: Observe the front-right drum, turn to look away, then look back.

tasks.title: 回头后金属桶材质改变

zh.criteria: 转身再回头后，金属桶突然变成紫红色，原有表面细节丢失。
zh.expected: 没有涂装或更换操作时，桶的外观应保持不变。
zh.steps: 观察前排左侧金属桶，转身再回头比较它的表面。

en.criteria: After the player looks away and back, the metal drum becomes magenta and loses its original surface detail.
en.expected: The drum’s appearance should remain unchanged without repainting or replacement.
en.steps: Observe the front-left drum, turn away, then look back and compare its surface.

zh.criteria: 离开再返回时，通道旁的椅子自行换了位置。
zh.expected: 无人推动时，椅子应保持原来的位置。
zh.steps: 先靠近看清椅子，转身走开至少四米，再沿原路返回。

en.criteria: After the player leaves and returns, the chair beside the aisle has moved by itself.
en.expected: The chair should remain in its original position when nobody pushes it.
en.steps: Approach and observe the chair, turn away and walk at least four meters, then return.

zh.criteria: 控制室中间的一把椅子悬在空中，轮脚与地板之间存在明显空隙。
zh.expected: 椅子的轮脚应接触地板。
zh.steps: 走到控制室中间，从侧面观察椅脚与地板之间的空隙。

en.criteria: A chair in the middle of the control room floats with a clear gap between its wheels and the floor.
en.expected: The chair wheels should rest on the floor.
en.steps: Walk toward the middle of the control room and inspect the gap beneath the chair.

zh.criteria: 两把椅子的椅背、座面和轮脚相互穿插。
zh.expected: 两把椅子应占据独立空间。
zh.steps: 靠近控制室中间的椅子，从不同角度观察交叉的座面和椅背。

en.criteria: Two chairs intersect through their backs, seats and wheel bases.
en.expected: The chairs should occupy separate spaces.
en.steps: Approach the chair in the middle of the control room and inspect the crossed seats and backs from different angles.

zh.criteria: 茶几相对椅子和杂志异常巨大，尺寸明显失调。
zh.expected: 茶几应保持与周围家具相称的尺寸。
zh.steps: 走到控制室休息区，比较茶几与附近椅子和杂志的比例。

en.criteria: The coffee table is oversized relative to the chairs and magazines.
en.expected: The coffee table should have proportions consistent with the surrounding furniture.
en.steps: Walk to the control room seating area and compare the table with nearby chairs and magazines.

zh.criteria: 人物可以从外观完整的椅子座面和椅背中直接穿过。
zh.expected: 椅子实体部分应阻挡人物。
zh.steps: 面向控制室中间的椅子，持续向前走尝试穿过座面。

en.criteria: The player can walk straight through the visible chair seat and back.
en.expected: The solid parts of the chair should block the player.
en.steps: Face the chair in the middle of the control room and walk forward through its seat.

tasks.title: 控制室椅子在正视时消失

zh.criteria: 墙边椅子移到视野中央时消失，稍微转开视角又出现。
zh.expected: 无遮挡的椅子应在这些视角下持续可见。
zh.steps: 靠近墙边椅子，正视后缓慢向左或向右转动视角。

en.criteria: The chair beside the wall disappears at the center of the view and reappears when the camera turns slightly.
en.expected: The unobstructed chair should remain visible across these viewpoints.
en.steps: Approach the chair beside the wall, look directly at it, then slowly turn left or right.

zh.criteria: 看向别处再回头后，茶几突然变成紫红色，原有表面外观丢失。
zh.expected: 无人更换或涂装时，茶几的外观应保持不变。
zh.steps: 先观察放有杂志的茶几，转身再回头比较桌面与桌腿。

en.criteria: After the player looks away and back, the coffee table turns magenta and loses its original surface appearance.
en.expected: The table’s appearance should remain unchanged without replacement or repainting.
en.steps: Observe the coffee table with magazines, turn away, then look back and compare its top and legs.

tasks.title: 机械臂空焊，工件托盘偏离作业位置

zh.criteria: 工件托盘偏离机械臂的作业位置，机械臂反复在空处执行焊接动作。
zh.expected: 正常情况下，工件托盘应与机械臂的焊接位置对齐。
zh.steps: 连续观察机械臂的动作和工件位置，再与正常对照比较。

en.criteria: The workpiece tray is displaced from the robot workstation, while the arm repeatedly follows its weld path through empty space.
en.expected: The workpiece tray should align with the robot’s welding path.
en.steps: Watch repeated arm movements and the workpiece position, then compare with the baseline.

tasks.title: Control-room light switches off by itself

zh.criteria: 控制室墙上原本亮着的灯在观察过程中突然自行熄灭。
zh.expected: 正常情况下，照明应持续工作，直到有人关闭开关。
zh.steps: 靠近目标并连续观察约六秒。

en.criteria: The illuminated wall light in the control room suddenly switches off while being observed.
en.expected: The light should keep operating until someone switches it off.
en.steps: Approach the target and watch it continuously for about six seconds.

tasks.title: Control-console computer shuts down by itself

zh.criteria: 控制台原本工作的屏幕和指示灯在观察过程中同时自行熄灭。
zh.expected: 正常情况下，控制台应持续运行，直到有人关闭电源。
zh.steps: 靠近目标并连续观察约六秒。

en.criteria: The operating control console suddenly loses its screen displays and indicator lights while being observed.
en.expected: The console should remain powered until someone shuts it down.
en.steps: Approach the target and watch it continuously for about six seconds.
